samples.title: Phân loại rác
samples.prompt: Your friend Alex wants to know about a neighbourhood recycling workshop. Write an email describing the activity, explaining the arrangements, and offering practical advice.
requirementsVi: Giới thiệu hoạt động và lợi ích.

samples.summaryVi: Phân loại cần thùng và hướng dẫn rõ, đồng thời hệ thống thu gom phải thực hiện đúng.

paragraphs.label: Mở thư
paragraphs.text:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for your email. You asked about a neighbourhood recycling workshop, so I am happy to share the details. I thought of you when I saw the programme because you enjoy learning useful things with other people.
paragraphs.noteVi: Cảm ơn, nhắc đúng câu hỏi của bạn.

paragraphs.label: Hoạt động
paragraphs.text: We will practise sorting common household items. The aim is to connect the topic with everyday life rather than only listen to a long talk. One useful point is that more recyclable material can be collected separately. For example, a family can keep a small box for clean bottles instead of putting them in the same bag as dinner leftovers.
paragraphs.noteVi: Phân loại cần thùng và hướng dẫn rõ, đồng thời hệ thống thu gom phải thực hiện đúng.

paragraphs.label: Sắp xếp và gợi ý
paragraphs.text: The session is at the community centre on Saturday at nine in the morning. Please bring a few clean empty containers and arrive about ten minutes early. If you want to prepare, think of one question about sorting household waste. We can compare our notes afterwards and decide which ideas would be useful in our own lives.
paragraphs.noteVi: Trả lời đủ thời gian, địa điểm, chuẩn bị.

paragraphs.label: Kết thư
paragraphs.text:
Please let me know what you think when you have a moment. I would be happy to answer any other questions.

Best wishes,
Minh
